G1_rules.note: Not a hardware designer's review. 228 rules kept (54 rejected, 3 merged). 20 spec-lint gaps and the review's open questions answered as spec section 8 decisions D-001..D-020 (made from the documents only; where the documents are silent the verification checks only bounds or the common part of every reading). The last 3 open questions answered: Status interrupts and fatal cause registers out of scope; alert handshake gap checked only through the D-009/D-010 bounds.

G2_contract.note: Not a hardware designer's review. 35 checks (13 assertions, 22 tests) over 151 rules; 77 rules not verified by simulation (mostly standard text outside this IP or obligations of the host). Checks follow spec decisions D-001..D-020: bounds instead of exact cycles where the documents are silent; d_error of instruction fetches and the response to an integrity-fault request are not checked.

G3_verif_sources.note: Not a hardware designer's review. Round 2 after formal: A17 (triage B) - CHK-003 treats a presented (not only accepted) intg-flip request as an alert cause (INT-INTG-002, D-010); CHK-004 stops checking IE_0 after an error-free write to 0x100 of a kind D-013 leaves unchecked (ie_unk) until the next modelled write. Assertions otherwise unchanged; weakening check clean; simulation 23/23. A13 (triage E feedback): ENV-08/ENV-10 track any write to CFG0/TIMER_V_* (RT-8-03); ENV-07 covers every write reaching lanes 0 and 3 of ALERT_TEST (RT-8-15). A13 declined to assume away non-contiguous masks (RT-4.1-05); that question is open.
